name: io.github.GabrielGauss/macropulse-mcp
title: MacroPulse
description: Daily US macro regime (expansion, recovery, tightening, risk-off) from MacroPulse.

environmentVariables.name: MACROPULSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MacroPulse API key. Optional: public tools work without it. Free key at https://macropulse.live; forecast, scorecard and liquidity need Starter or Pro.

environmentVariables.name: MACROPULSE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API URL override for testing (https only). Default: https://api.macropulse.live
